pr_body:

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/43597

Problem Summary:
When innerWorkerRuntimeStats.join is negative, `join:` will not print.
When innerWorkerRuntimeStats.join is 9223372036854775807,  FormatDuration will overflow and print -2562047h47m16.809551616s

### What is changed and how it works?
